cards.question: Что такое Laravel?
cards.reference: PHP-фреймворк для веб-приложений: роутинг, ORM Eloquent, Blade, очереди, тесты. Точка входа public/index.php, ядро — IoC-контейнер.

cards.question: Структура каталогов Laravel?
cards.reference: app/ — код приложения; routes/ — маршруты; resources/views — Blade; database/migrations; config/; bootstrap/; public/ — document root.

cards.question: Назначение artisan?
cards.reference: CLI Laravel: migrate, make:model, queue:work, route:list, tinker, schedule:run. Расширяется custom commands в app/Console/Commands.

cards.question: Что делает composer.json scripts post-autoload-dump?
cards.reference: Запускает @php artisan package:discover и обновляет bootstrap/cache/packages.php — автoregistration пакетов.

cards.question: Файл .env и APP_KEY?
cards.reference: .env — локальные секреты; php artisan key:generate создаёт APP_KEY для шифрования cookies/sessions.

cards.question: В чём разница между config() и env()?
cards.reference: config() — из config/*.php с кэшем; env() только в config-файлах, не в коде приложения (иначе null после config:cache).

cards.question: bootstrap/app.php (Laravel 11+)?
cards.reference: Конфигурация приложения: withRouting, withMiddleware, withExceptions — замена части Kernel bootstrap.

cards.question: Service providers — роль?
cards.reference: Регистрация bindings, routes, events в register()/boot(); auto-discovery через composer.

cards.question: Публикация конфигов пакетов?
cards.reference: php artisan vendor:publish --tag=config копирует config в приложение.

cards.question: Поясните: Homestead / Sail.
cards.reference: Laravel Sail — Docker-окружение для dev; официальные образы PHP, MySQL, Redis, Mailpit.

cards.question: Mix / Vite в Laravel?
cards.reference: Сборка фронтенда: vite.config.js + @vite в Blade; npm run dev / build.

cards.question: storage/ и bootstrap/cache/?
cards.reference: storage/logs, framework/cache, sessions; bootstrap/cache — compiled config/routes (artisan optimize).

cards.question: Поясните: php artisan about.
cards.reference: Сводка версий Laravel, PHP, drivers cache/queue/session/database.

cards.question: Поясните: Maintenance mode.
cards.reference: php artisan down / up; secret bypass token; prerender страница 503.

cards.question: Где объявляются web-маршруты?
cards.reference: routes/web.php — middleware web (session, CSRF). API — routes/api.php с prefix api и middleware api.

cards.question: Поясните: Optional parameters.
cards.reference: {slug?} с default в closure/controller: function ($slug = null).

cards.question: Поясните: Route model binding.
cards.reference: Type-hint Post $post — Laravel resolve по id; custom binding в RouteServiceProvider/boot.

cards.question: Implicit vs explicit binding?
cards.reference: Implicit — по type-hint; explicit Route::bind('user', fn ($v) => User::where(...)->firstOrFail()).

cards.question: Поясните: Route caching.
cards.reference: php artisan route:cache — production; route:clear при изменении маршрутов.

cards.question: Поясните: Resource routes.
cards.reference: Route::resource('photos', PhotoController::class) — index, create, store, show, edit, update, destroy.

cards.question: В чём разница между apiResource и resource?
cards.reference: apiResource без create/edit — JSON API CRUD.

cards.question: Поясните: Controller middleware.
cards.reference: $this->middleware('auth')->only('store'); или в конструкторе — attribute Middleware в Laravel 11.

cards.question: Поясните: Form Request.
cards.reference: php artisan make:request StorePostRequest — authorize() + rules(); type-hint в controller method.

cards.question: Dependency injection в controller?
cards.reference: Constructor или method injection — Laravel resolve из container: public function store(PostService $svc).

cards.question: Resource controller methods?
cards.reference: index, create, store, show, edit, update, destroy — REST соглашения.

cards.question: Controller vs Closure routes?
cards.reference: Closure для простых; controllers для тестируемости и reuse.

cards.question: Поясните: back() helper.
cards.reference: redirect()->back() с input old() после validation errors.

cards.question: Поясните: old() helper.
cards.reference: old('email') — repopulate form после failed validation.

cards.question: Active Record в Eloquent?
cards.reference: Model class = таблица (posts); экземпляр = строка; Post::find(1), $post->save().

cards.question: Поясните: hasMany / hasOne.
cards.reference: User hasMany Post::class; hasOne Profile::class — foreign key на child.

cards.question: Поясните: belongsToMany pivot.
cards.reference: attach, detach, sync; withPivot('expires_at'); timestamps на pivot.

cards.question: Поясните: Eager loading N+1.
cards.reference: Post::with('user')->get(); — один запрос для relation вместо N.

cards.question: Поясните: Soft deletes.
cards.reference: use SoftDeletes; deleted_at; withTrashed(), onlyTrashed(), restore(), forceDelete().

cards.question: Accessors / mutators (Laravel 9+)?
cards.reference: protected function title(): Attribute { return Attribute::make(get: fn ($v) => ucfirst($v)); }

cards.question: В чём разница между Query builder и Eloquent?
cards.reference: DB::table('users') — без model events; User::query() — Eloquent builder с scopes.

cards.question: chunk() и cursor()?
cards.reference: Обработка больших таблиц без загрузки всего: User::chunk(100, fn ($users) => ...); cursor() lazy generator.

cards.question: Поясните: migrate / rollback.
cards.reference: php artisan migrate; migrate:rollback --step=1; migrate:fresh --seed (dev only!).

cards.question: Поясните: Migration naming order.
cards.reference: Timestamp prefix ensures order; не редактировать applied migrations в prod.

cards.question: Поясните: Enum column.
cards.reference: $table->enum('status', ['draft','published']); или string + PHP enum cast Laravel 9+.

cards.question: Расширение .blade.php?
cards.reference: Blade компилируется в PHP; views в resources/views; view('posts.index', compact('posts')).

cards.question: Поясните: Components <x-alert>.
cards.reference: php artisan make:component Alert; class + view resources/views/components/alert.blade.php.

cards.question: Поясните: @once directive.
cards.reference: Include/push один раз за render — assets dedup.

cards.question: @csrf в forms?
cards.reference: Hidden token для web middleware CSRF verification.

cards.question: Что такое @method('PUT')?
cards.reference: Spoof HTTP method для HTML forms: PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

cards.question: Что такое @verbatim?
cards.reference: Отключить Blade parsing для @{{ vue }} шаблонов.

cards.question: Что такое middleware?
cards.reference: HTTP pipeline filters: request → middleware chain → controller → response → middleware (terminate).

cards.question: Middleware groups web и api?
cards.reference: web: session, cookie encryption, CSRF; api: throttle, bindings, stateless default.

cards.question: Создание middleware?
cards.reference: php artisan make:middleware EnsureUserIsAdmin; handle(Request $request, Closure $next).

cards.question: Поясните: Middleware parameters.
cards.reference: middleware('role:admin') — третий аргумент $role в handle после $next.

cards.question: Before vs after middleware?
cards.reference: handle до $next — до controller; код после $next($request) — после response.

cards.question: Что такое SubstituteBindings?
cards.reference: Route model binding middleware в группе web/api.

cards.question: Что такое TrustProxies?
cards.reference: Correct HTTPS behind load balancer — X-Forwarded-* headers.

cards.question: Что такое ThrottleRequests?
cards.reference: Rate limit by key — user id or IP.

cards.question: Поясните: Terminate middleware.
cards.reference: Middleware с terminate() — после отправки response (logging).

cards.question: Что такое RedirectIfAuthenticated?
cards.reference: Guest routes — redirect logged-in users from login/register.

cards.question: Поясните: Custom validation rule.
cards.reference: php artisan make:rule Uppercase; implements ValidationRule invoke method.

cards.question: sometimes и nullable?
cards.reference: Поле validate только если present; nullable — null allowed.

cards.question: Поясните: Validation attributes.
cards.reference: attributes() human names для error messages.

cards.question: Что такое stopOnFirstFailure?
cards.reference: Validator::stopOnFirstFailure() — одна ошибка на field batch.

cards.question: Что такое prepareForValidation?
cards.reference: FormRequest hook normalize input before rules.

cards.question: Laravel Breeze / Jetstream / Fortify?
cards.reference: Starter kits: Breeze minimal; Jetstream teams/2FA; Fortify headless auth backend.

cards.question: В чём разница между Sanctum SPA и token?
cards.reference: SPA cookie session + CSRF; API tokens HasApiTokens personal access tokens.

cards.question: Guards и providers?
cards.reference: guards: web (session), sanctum; providers: eloquent User model.

cards.question: Поясните: Password hashing.
cards.reference: Hash::make / bcrypt; cast 'password' => 'hashed' auto on set Laravel 10+.

cards.question: Поясните: Email verification.
cards.reference: MustVerifyEmail contract; middleware verified; signed verification URL.

cards.question: Зачем queues?
cards.reference: Async jobs: mail, webhooks, heavy processing — не блокировать HTTP response.

cards.question: Поясните: Job class.
cards.reference: php artisan make:job ProcessPodcast; implements ShouldQueue; handle() method.

cards.question: Поясните: Queue drivers.
cards.reference: sync (dev), database, redis, sqs — config/queue.php QUEUE_CONNECTION.

cards.question: Что такое queue:work?
cards.reference: php artisan queue:work redis --tries=3 --timeout=90; supervisor in production.

cards.question: Поясните: Failed jobs.
cards.reference: failed_jobs table; queue:failed, retry, flush; FailedJob event.

cards.question: Поясните: ShouldQueue interface.
cards.reference: Job queued; без него — sync execution even if dispatched to queue.

cards.question: Поясните: SerializesModels trait.
cards.reference: Eloquent models in jobs serialized by id; re-fetch on handle.

cards.question: Поясните: Chain jobs.
cards.reference: Bus::chain([new A, new B, new C])->dispatch(); sequential.

cards.question: Что такое Horizon?
cards.reference: Redis queue dashboard for Laravel — metrics, workers, failed jobs UI.

cards.question: Поясните: Unique jobs.
cards.reference: ShouldBeUnique — prevent duplicate same job queued.

cards.question: Поясните: afterCommit dispatch.
cards.reference: dispatch()->afterCommit() — только после DB transaction commit.

cards.question: Event / Listener pattern?
cards.reference: event(new OrderShipped($order)); EventServiceProvider listen array or discover.

cards.question: Поясните: Subscriber class.
cards.reference: subscribe() returns event=>method map — multiple events one class.

cards.question: Поясните: Model events.
cards.reference: creating, created, updating, updated, deleting — boot() callbacks or Observers.

cards.question: Что такое Observer?
cards.reference: php artisan make:observer UserObserver --model=User; register in AppServiceProvider.

cards.question: Поясните: dispatch helper.
cards.reference: OrderShipped::dispatch($order) if event uses Dispatchable trait.

cards.question: Поясните: Synchronous default.
cards.reference: Listeners sync unless ShouldQueue — order matters.

cards.question: В чём разница между Notification и Event?
cards.reference: Notifications user-facing channels; Events internal domain decoupling.

cards.question: Поясните: Event sourcing note.
cards.reference: Laravel events not full event sourcing — use packages for audit log.

cards.question: Поясните: PHPUnit / Pest.
cards.reference: tests/Feature и tests/Unit; php artisan test; Pest expressive syntax optional.

cards.question: Поясните: RefreshDatabase trait.
cards.reference: Migrate fresh each test — isolated DB state.

cards.question: Что такое assertJsonStructure?
cards.reference: API testing JSON shape and values assertJson(['id' => 1]).

cards.question: Поясните: Dusk browser tests.
cards.reference: Laravel Dusk — ChromeDriver E2E (legacy for many teams).

cards.question: Поясните: WithoutMiddleware trait.
cards.reference: Disable middleware for isolated controller test — use cautiously.

cards.question: Поясните: API routes prefix.
cards.reference: routes/api.php — /api/*; default throttle:api; no CSRF session.

cards.question: Поясните: API Resources.
cards.reference: php artisan make:resource PostResource; toArray(Request $request) transform output.

cards.question: Поясните: API versioning.
cards.reference: Route::prefix('v1')->group(...); or Accept header versioning custom.

cards.question: Что такое CORS?
cards.reference: config/cors.php; fruitcake/laravel-cors or built-in HandleCors middleware.

cards.question: Поясните: Conditional requests.
cards.reference: ETag / Last-Modified — optional middleware packages or custom.

cards.question: Поясните: API exception handling.
cards.reference: Handler render JSON for ValidationException 422 unified errors.

cards.question: Поясните: Scribe / OpenAPI.
cards.reference: Documentation generators from routes and FormRequests.

cards.question: Поясните: HATEOAS in Laravel.
cards.reference: Not built-in — add links in API Resources manually.

cards.question: Поясните: JSON:API spec.
cards.reference: Packages spatie/laravel-json-api or custom Resource structure.

cards.question: Поясните: Postman collection.
cards.reference: Export from Scribe or OpenAPI for QA.

cards.question: Поясните: IoC container Laravel.
cards.reference: Resolve class dependencies automatically — bind interfaces to implementations.

cards.question: В чём разница между App::bind и singleton?
cards.reference: bind — new instance each resolve; singleton — shared instance app lifecycle.

cards.question: Service provider register vs boot?
cards.reference: register — bindings only; boot — routes, views, after all providers registered.

cards.question: Поясните: Concrete auto-resolution.
cards.reference: No binding needed if class concrete and dependencies resolvable.

cards.question: Поясните: Deferred providers.
cards.reference: Defer loading until service first requested — performance.

cards.question: Поясните: Method injection.
cards.reference: Route/controller method params resolved from container.

cards.question: Поясните: Tagged bindings.
cards.reference: bind tag collections for multiple implementations strategy pattern.

cards.question: Поясните: Service container facades.
cards.reference: Facade root accessor resolves from container singleton.

cards.question: Поясните: Octane note.
cards.reference: Singleton state persists between requests — avoid mutable state in bindings.

cards.question: Collection vs Eloquent Collection?
cards.reference: Eloquent\Collection extends Support\Collection with model helpers load(), find().

cards.question: В чём разница между toArray и all?
cards.reference: all() internal items; toArray() recursive array conversion.

cards.question: В чём разница между Arr helper и Collection?
cards.reference: Arr::get, Arr::wrap — static array utils; collect for chaining.

cards.question: Поясните: Enumerable contract.
cards.reference: Common interface Collection and LazyCollection — consistent API.

cards.question: Mass assignment в PostController
cards.task: Разреши mass assignment только title и body через fillable.

cards.question: Dispatch job
cards.task: Отправь ProcessOrder в очередь через dispatch.

cards.question: Event dispatch
cards.task: Вызови event OrderPlaced после создания заказа.

cards.question: API Resource
Collection pipeline
cards.task: Используй collect для фильтрации активных пользователей.

cards.question: env() в controller
cards.task: Используй config() вместо env() в runtime коде.

cards.question: Controller injection
Route model binding
Blade component
